IRext decoder (https://github.com/irext/irext-core, decoder/src), version 1.6.0,
MIT licence (LICENSE).  Unmodified; the headers sit next to the sources so the
Arduino build needs no include path, and the JNI binding and the test program
are left out.  Used by ac_core for air conditioners; the code database is
packed onto the TF card by tools/pack_irdb.py.
